meaning_es: Un proveedor presenta una caída anormal de aprobación
recommended_action: Check provider status, compare performance with alternative providers, and evaluate temporary routing alternatives

meaning_es: Los rechazos se concentran en un banco emisor específico
recommended_action: Escalate the bank-specific issue, monitor other issuers, and verify whether the problem is isolated

meaning_es: Un método de pago presenta deterioro anormal
recommended_action: Verify payment method availability, configuration, provider connectivity, and recent changes

meaning_es: El problema afecta principalmente a un merchant
recommended_action: Review merchant configuration, recent changes, routing rules, and transaction patterns

meaning_es: La degradación está concentrada en un país
recommended_action: Compare providers and payment methods in the affected country and investigate local dependencies

meaning_es: Un código de rechazo aumenta de forma anormal
recommended_action: Identify which provider, bank, merchant, or method is generating the decline code and investigate the related dependency

meaning_es: Aumenta el tiempo de procesamiento de pagos
recommended_action: Review provider/API latency, infrastructure performance, and recent technical changes

meaning_es: Los reintentos dejan de recuperar pagos al nivel esperado
recommended_action: Review retry logic, recovery performance, and failure patterns

meaning_es: Existen dos o más incidentes independientes al mismo tiempo
recommended_action: Separate incidents, calculate impact individually, and prioritize them according to severity and financial exposure

meaning_es: Existe una anomalía, pero no hay evidencia suficiente para confirmar la causa
recommended_action: Continue monitoring, collect additional evidence, and avoid confirming an unsupported root cause
